 Xiaomi reveals 11.11 sale deals; up to Php 15,000 in discounts
 Xiaomi reveals 11.11 sale deals; up to Php 15,000 in discounts
 Unbox Staff 
 November 4, 2026 
 Xiaomi and POCO kick off their 11.11 Mega Sale deals in Shopee and Lazada starting November 6, with special deals lasting until November 15. Users can save up to Php 13,000 on select Xiaomi products and up to Php 15,000 on select POCO products. Xiaomi will also be offering exclusive AIoT bundles as well, along with free shipping, additional discount vouchers, and buy now pay later options.
 The savings kick off on Shopee from November 6 to 15 and on Lazada from November 10 (8:00 PM) to November 15. Shoppers should set their alarms for the Peak Flash Sale Window starting November 10 at 8:00 PM through November 11 , where the biggest discounts of the season will drop.
